title: Golden tests page should use .json.gz exports instead of parsing LLM prompt JSON
description:
The golden tests page (website/src/pages/golden.astro) currently reads the raw golden prompt JSON files from puppeteer/tests/golden/prompts/ and parses tool results inline to extract game state. This is fragile — it broke when the dark_depths_combo test exceeded 40 history entries, causing _render_context to summarize older tool results to compact text instead of JSON (fixed with a workaround in ac90628f9f).

The golden tests should instead output a .json.gz file alongside the LLM prompt JSON (the same export format used by real games in website/public/games/). Then golden.astro can use the normal .gz parsing and game rendering pipeline that already works for the games list and game viewer pages. This eliminates the custom JSON extraction logic in golden.astro entirely and ensures golden test rendering stays in sync with the main game viewer.
